SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date. December 18, 1933.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. DIRECTORY. / No. D 5541 / Branch ... / Date 18/12/33）

Subject (in full) Special Enquiry - The recent communist activities in Shanghai.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the endorsement of the Officer i/c
Special Branch on the attached report, I have to state that the
major portion of the information contained in the report relates
to the 6th Anniversary of the Canton Uprising which fell on .
December 11, 1933, which has already been dealt with in reports
submitted by the undersigned prior to the anniversary in question
(vide File D-5499).

Other information to the effect that members of the
Special Squad of the Chinese Communist Party would capture
police stations cannot be regarded as authentic.

（批：yR）

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：File / [签名] / DEC. 18 1933）

日期：1933年12月18日。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号：DIRECTORY. / 编号 D 5541 / 科室 ... / 日期 1933年12月18日）

事由（全称） 特别调查——上海近期的共产主义活动。

呈报人：督察 顾宝华 转呈人 [签名]

鉴于特别科主管警官在附件报告上的批注，本人谨声明，该报告所载大部分信息涉及1933年12月11日的广州起义六周年纪念，此事已在本人于该纪念日前提交的报告中予以处理（参见档案 D-5499）。

另有关于中国共产党特别队成员将攻占警察局的消息，不能视为属实。

（批注：yR）

顾宝华
督察

特别科主管警官。

（批注：归档 / [签名] / 1933年12月18日）

SPECIAL INQUIRY
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 5541
the recent activities of Communists in Shanghai
19/12/33

 In order to co-operate with the Fukien "Puppet" Government,
the communists in Shanghai have decided to stage a riot
before or after the 15th. inst. The proceedings of this
disturbance are as follows :-
① Flags will be distributed to the rioters and hoisted
concurrently in the evening at various points in the Settlement, French Concession,
and Chinese City.
② In commemoration of the big uprising at Canton
in 1927.
③ During the tumult the Youth Group of the Communists,
and the Agricultural & Industrial Corps and the Special
Squad will lead the way and destroy military
and Police institutions, where, if possible, fire-arms
will be seized.

② For the past few days the communists have met
together privately, and when the following resolutions
were passed on :-
Since Chen Ming Chu has provided $ 60,000.00
& 250,000 rounds of ammunition for our Government,
every effort should be made by us to ensure
a great success.

③ When the riot is in progress, workmen will be despatched
in r/cars, from which hand bills are
to be distributed. Others will in the same time hoist
flags and set off fire-crackers.

④ For fear of unavoidable danger, the actual members
of communists will not participate in the front but
will remain behind to superintend the
staff.
Pd, Please verify and include submit
for inclusion in D.I. Report anything likely to
prove useful.
19/12/33

特别调查
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处
编号 D 5541
上海共产主义者近期活动
1933年12月19日

为配合福建“伪”政府，上海的共产主义者已决定在本月15日前后发动暴乱。此次骚乱的行动步骤如下：
① 向暴乱分子分发旗帜，并于当晚在租界、法租界及华界各要点同时升起。
② 以此纪念1927年的广州大起义。
③ 在骚乱期间，由共产主义青年团、农工纠察队及特别队打头阵，摧毁军事和警察机构，并在可能情况下缴获枪支。

② 近几日，共产主义者私下集会，并通过以下决议：
鉴于陈铭枢已为我方政府提供60,000.00美元及250,000发弹药，我方应竭尽全力确保取得重大成功。

③ 暴乱进行时，将派遣工人乘坐人力车，从中散发传单。其他人则同时升旗并燃放鞭炮。

④ 出于对不可避免之危险的顾虑，共产主义核心成员不会参与前线行动，而是留在后方监督人员。
Pd，请核实并将任何可能有用的内容纳入督察报告中提交。
1933年12月19日
